d: Jet black hair with choppy bangs and a messy texture, partially covered by a dark purple wide-brimmed hat. Golden-brown eyes with a confident, sly expression, set on a face with the maturity of a young adult. A lean build, wearing a bright crimson open overcoat over a grey cropped top and dark purple wide-leg trousers, accessorized by a belt featuring three large silver heart-shaped buckles. Signature details include a single black leather glove on the right hand and large silver hoop earrings.
